title: Follow the opening suit again
prompt: Barbu opened with 2C. With this different hand, which card must you play?

title: Leave the next lead again
prompt: Clubs were led. Follow suit and leave the lead to someone else; this is a tactic, not a rule.

title: Another opening discard
prompt: You have no clubs on the opening trick. Choose a legal discard without points.

title: Avoid a point in diamonds
prompt: Diamonds were led. Right holds the lead with KD and Left may discard a heart. Follow diamonds without winning.

title: Use a different void

title: Follow hearts without winning
prompt: Hearts were led. Right is winning with QH. Follow hearts and stay below that queen.

title: Leave the queen with the winner
prompt: Right played QS after a spade lead. Which spade lets you avoid its 13 points?

title: Move the queen on diamonds
prompt: Diamonds were led. You have none. Use this void to pass the queen's points to the trick winner.

title: Keep the queen below cover
prompt: Spades were led. The highest spade so far is 10S. Follow suit without winning your own queen.

title: Lead from another all-heart hand
prompt: No heart has been played, but only hearts remain in your hand. Choose a legal lead.

title: Follow another heart lead
prompt: Barbu led 3H. Right discarded a diamond because they have no hearts. You still have a heart: what must you play?

title: Lead after hearts are broken
prompt: Hearts are broken. You lead from this new hand. Choose any legal suit.

title: Break a moon attempt in diamonds

title: Take the queen away from a moon attempt
prompt: Barbu has all points so far and leads QS. Follow spades and take these points away from Barbu.

title: Win hearts to stop the moon
prompt: Barbu has all points so far and leads KH. Take this heart trick to prevent one player collecting every point.

title: Find the 13-point card again
prompt: Which card adds 13 points to the player who captures it?

title: Find a different one-point card

title: Find another clean card
